assessment: The possibility that hypoxia signaling pathways exert control over immunity by actions on regulatory T lymphocytes is of great interest given that immune inflammatory pathology is often associated with hypoxia. This article supports the cell-intrinsic role of a specific isoform of hypoxia-inducible factor 2 (HIF2) in reducing the function of these cells when HIF is activated by inactivation of its regulatory hydroxylase. Aside from the biology, this is important because both HIF activators and specific HIF-2 inhibitors are in use clinically.
